scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: The club laptop loses a pretend project folder during a classroom exercise. Kabir points to a shortcut on its desktop, but the shortcut leads to the same missing file. Meera checks whether a separate approved copy can actually open.
scenes.speech: The club laptop loses a pretend project folder during a classroom exercise. Kabir points to a shortcut on its desktop, but the shortcut leads to the same missing file. Meera checks whether a separate approved copy can actually open.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: A backup is a recoverable copy kept through an approved method. Another icon is not enough. Two copies on the same lost device may disappear together, so the team asks which problem the backup is meant to survive before trusting it.
scenes.speech: A backup is a recoverable copy kept through an approved method. Another icon is not enough. Two copies on the same lost device may disappear together, so the team asks which problem the backup is meant to survive before trusting it.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: The teacher restores a fictional file and compares its contents with the expected version. Updates also need the known device settings and adult approval. A sudden webpage warning is not an instruction to download a repair tool or give remote access.
scenes.speech: The teacher restores a fictional file and compares its contents with the expected version. Updates also need the known device settings and adult approval. A sudden webpage warning is not an instruction to download a repair tool or give remote access.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: The teacher’s approved backup is on a separate school system. A desktop shortcut and duplicate folder are both on the laptop. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.speech: The teacher’s approved backup is on a separate school system. A desktop shortcut and duplicate folder are both on the laptop. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.dialogue: Which copy survives losing the club laptop?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: Use the separate approved backup and test the restored file. A copy is useful only if it survives the problem and contains the needed work.
scenes.speech: Use the separate approved backup and test the restored file. A copy is useful only if it survives the problem and contains the needed work.
scenes.dialogue: Choose a backup surviving the stated loss.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through original and backup, then recovery checks, then safe update habits. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
